notes.key_messages:
• Candidates need to read through a question carefully before attempting to answer it.
• Candidates need to show their working in mathematical questions, where a final answer is incorrect
often credit can be obtained from correct working.
• Candidates should write clearly in black or dark blue ink and should not overwrite any pencil working.
notes.general_comments: This paper differentiated well with no evidence of candidates being short of time.
